code_snippet.code:
from rlm import RLM

rlm = RLM(
    backend="openai",
    backend_kwargs={"model_name": "gpt-5-nano"},
    verbose=True,
)

print(rlm.completion("Print the first 100 powers of two, each on a newline.").response)
code_snippet.caption: Instantiate RLM with any backend and call rlm.completion() where you would call llm.completion(). The recursive decomposition hides behind the same single call.

export LMCACHE_CHUNK_SIZE="256"
export LMCACHE_LOCAL_CPU="True"
export LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE="5.0"

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --kv-transfer-config \
  '{"kv_connector":"LMCacheConnectorV1","kv_role":"kv_both"}'
